description: This Java class 'ConnectionLoggerRegistry' manages loggers for connectivity services, including initialization, aggregation, muting, unmuting, and log collection for specific connections. It handles log capacity, log sizing, and metadata management for logging durations, and provides methods for getting category-specific and connection-specific loggers.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerRegistry
classes.description: Manages loggers for connectivity, allowing log aggregation, muting, unmuting, and initialization per connection, with metadata management for logging durations and size restrictions.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates a new registry instance from a given configuration object.

methods.name: aggregateLogs
methods.description: Collects and returns aggregated logs for a specific connection ID.

methods.name: restrictMaxLogEntriesLength
methods.description: Limits the number of log entries based on maximum byte size.

methods.name: isActiveForConnection
methods.description: Checks whether logging is active for a specific connection.

methods.name: isLoggingExpired
methods.description: Determines if logging for a connection has expired based on timestamp.

methods.name: muteForConnection
methods.description: Mutes logging for a specific connection.

methods.name: unmuteForConnection
methods.description: Unmutes or activates logging for a specific connection.

methods.name: streamLoggers
methods.description: Streams the loggers associated with a connection ID.

methods.name: initForConnection
methods.description: Initializes loggers for a new connection based on sources and targets.

methods.name: initLogger
methods.description: Initializes a specific logger based on connection ID, category, and optional address.

methods.name: resetForConnection
methods.description: Resets all loggers for a connection, clearing stored logs.

methods.name: resetForConnectionId

methods.name: refreshMetadata
methods.description: Extends the logging duration metadata for a connection.

methods.name: startMetadata
methods.description: Starts logging duration metadata for a connection.

methods.name: stopMetadata
methods.description: Stops and removes metadata for a connection.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a connection.
